hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Augment the search state to track cell coordinates, arriving direction, and remaining allowed direction turns.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Use a min-priority queue ordered by path cost to expand lowest cumulative weights first.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Prune redundant states when a state with fewer or equal turns has already been reached with equal or lower cost.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(m * n * k * log(m * n * k))
complexity.notes: Priority queue over expanded states (r, c, direction, turns_used).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard shortest path ignores direction change penalties and turn limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance table of size m * n * 4 * (k + 1) stores minimum costs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models direction and turn count directly into Dijkstra state.
